summary: In this event, contestants demonstrate their intermediate word processing skills by creating, editing, and formatting various business documents. Participants complete all work on-site and may also take the MOS Word 365 Associate certification at the national level. The event is open to secondary and postsecondary students who have not previously competed in Intermediate or Advanced Word Processing.
time_limits: No more than ten (10) minutes orientation
No more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
No more than ten (10) minutes wrap-up
No more than fifty (50) minutes for certification test
submission_requirements: All contestant-produced jobs completed on-site are uploaded electronically and are not printed at the national level
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
competencies: Demonstrate the ability to produce structured business documents using intermediate formatting tools, including styles, templates, section breaks, multi-column layouts, mail merge and layout features
Design and format tables and insert visual elements such as graphics, icons, and charts using built-in styles, alignment tools, and accessibility features
Edit and proofread documents using collaborative features such as tracked changes, comments, and utilize digital reference resources
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed

Previous Business Professionals of America tests and/or sample tests (handwritten, photocopied or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
At NLC, contestants will take MOS Word 365 Associate certification as part of the event. Contestants passing this certification will have 50 points added to their event score.
A Pearson profile must be created at https://certiport.pearsonvue.com before attending NLC
Contestants must include their BPA Contestant ID in their Pearson profile when they register
Certiport Parent/Legal Guardian Consent Form must be uploaded to: education@bpa.org
Reference materials are not allowed for certification testing
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this application event.
Contestants who have previously competed in Intermediate or Advanced Word Processing cannot enter this event.
Contestants may participate in only one of these events each year.
